description: V0.7c pipeline check (docs/benchmark/v07c-dev/PLAN.md §2), run before the plan was committed: the five policies on one entry, one seed, 3 days, to check that both models answer under 0.7.0-dev.3 and that the runner, replay and analysis work. Not a result. no action, greedy, conservative-v2 and the two frozen LLM agents (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Gemma 4 26B-A4B) on the five -credit entries of suite dreamteam-dev version 3 (radiologist overtime paid; a $50,000 credit line at 10% and the funding rule), daily decisions at 07:00. No score, no ranking. Run from the repository root with DREAMTEAM_LLM_BASE_URL set.
seedPlan: Chosen 2026-10-29 and committed in the V0.7c plan (docs/benchmark/v07c-dev/PLAN.md) before any run on them: the next unused block after V0.7b's 41501-41503: 41600 for the pipeline check (3 days, one entry; not a result), 41601 and 41602 for stage A, 41701 for stage B, all fixed before any run of either stage. None appeared in the repository before; not a reference seed (1001-1020), not a V0.2 development seed (901-910), not drawn from any reserved stream, not a benchmark holdout seed (none exists); the sealed clinical holdout guard accepts them.
